title: Can a single 'meta' steering vector generalize across several related safety concepts?

original_idea.body: Extract vectors for ~5 related integrity concepts, compute a shared direction (mean/PCA), and test whether it steers/detects each constituent nearly as well as dedicated vectors.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: a meta-direction would simplify safety monitoring, but link skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: PCA/mean of related vectors + coverage test; beginner-feasible.

novelty.reasoning: Concept-direction PCA studied; meta-direction for safety families may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Shared-geometry meta-direction may be partly open.
